newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Eastman Kodak raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Eastman Kodak raised to buy.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities said it upgraded its rating of Eastman Kodak Co to a buy from a hold on Monday.
-- Eastman Kodak shares closed at 81 on Friday.

-- Analyst B. Alexander Henderson said stock has been lagging behind the overall market since the beginning of July market, with the market up 15 percent compared with Eastman Kodak's rise of about four percent.
-- "It's also a defensive buy -- they should do well in a weakening economic environment," he said.

-- "And October film sales looked relatively strong with sales of 35 millimeter film up about five percent, suggesting a good Christmas selling season for the company. With those three factors, we feel it's reasonable to declare victory on our hold rating and go to buy," he said.
